specs.value: Complete, active planted-tank soil. It can be used on its own with no separate bottom layer
1–1.5 mm 'extra fine'; regular Aquarium Soil is 2–3 mm
Lowers pH slightly and has a mild effect on water chemistry

variants.name: Tropica Aquarium Soil (regular grain, sister product)

prices.variant: Tropica Aquarium Soil 9 L, regular 2–3 mm grain (not Powder). I found no VND price for the Powder version on any Vietnamese shop site
Tropica Aquarium Soil 9 L, regular 2–3 mm grain (not Powder)

fits.fact: The fine grain suits small and foreground plants, and it can be used for a new tank's whole bed or as a finer foreground area
The smaller grain works well for short-rooted carpet plants
It can be spread as a fine top layer over the regular-grain Tropica Aquarium Soil
In a seller's own test tanks, carpet plants rooted reliably and growth was steady rather than explosive. Heavy root feeders may need root tabs after about 9–12 months
Vietnamese shops sell the regular Tropica soil for planted tanks, shrimp tanks and fish tanks

usage.fact: To work out how many litres you need, multiply length × width × bed depth in cm and divide by 1000. For example, a 90×60 cm tank with an 8 cm bed needs about 43 L
For the first 4 weeks after setup, change 25–50% of the water at least twice a week
Spread it straight into a clean tank with no underlayer. You can slope it for depth. Fill the tank gently so the bed isn't stirred up, then plant and start the filter
A Vietnamese shop advises a bed of about 5–7 cm for Tropica soil
After opening, keep the bag sealed and store it somewhere cool and dry, out of the sun
In one seller's tests, KH dropped to about 1 dKH and pH stayed below 6.8 for about 12 months, rising to around 7.0 by month 14

issues.fact: It releases ammonia when new. One seller measured a peak of about 1.5–2 ppm in the first 4 days, falling below 0.25 ppm by day 14, with full cycling taking 3–4 weeks
Forum users report cloudy water after setup or when the bed is disturbed. In one case it stayed murky for about 48 hours
Retailers disagree on grain size (1–1.5 mm, 1–2 mm or under 2 mm), so check the bag
The granules reportedly keep their shape with little compaction even after 18 months, which helps if you rescape
Vietnamese shops mostly stock only the regular 9 L soil (2–3 mm), so you may need to order the Powder version specially

alternatives.why: It is the same formula with a coarser 2–3 mm grain and is easy to buy in Vietnam for about 790,000–850,000 VND. It suits the mid- and background areas
It is the premium fine-grain choice. It lowers pH more strongly (to about 5.8–6.0) and gives faster plant growth, but it is pricier and takes longer to cycle with more ammonia
It is a comparable European soil. One review found it buffers for a shorter time than Tropica and stores fewer nutrients
